stubBoundary.execution: Frozen source slices are executed character-for-character inside node:vm; every emitted number is produced by original source code.
stubBoundary.three: THREE is a recording stub (Group/Mesh/Sprite/Points/PointLight, materials, buffer geometries/attributes, canvas textures). Positions, rotations, scales, colors, opacities and intensities are plain inspectable data; no rendering happens.
stubBoundary.canvas2d: The 2D context is a recording stub: the fill/stroke/roundRect/fillText/fillRect command stream is kept as data so status-board and billboard text/color output is verifiable. No pixels are rasterized.
stubBoundary.clock: Date.now() is replaced by a declared monotonic clock: clockStartMs + tick * clockMsPerTick (16 ms per declared 0.016 s frame). The frozen page calls the behavior tree with a hard-coded 0.016 s step and samples the wall clock for flash/pulse phases; both are deterministic here.
stubBoundary.random: Math.random() is replaced by a declared 32-bit LCG (Math.imul(state, 1664525) + 1013904223, seed = scenario.seed). Draw order follows the frozen build: createAirlockVortexParticles (5 draws x 70 particles), then one createAirShower timer draw per chamber.
stubBoundary.catalogRecords: The two frozen air-shower chambers are built with createAirShower using the original dimension/amber options and positions; the catalog equipment record substituted as eqData is reduced to {id} because catalog metadata feeds no timing math.
stubBoundary.operatorUserDataOverwrite: Frozen buildCleanroomPersonnel overwrites operator.userData at twin.html:9517/9530, discarding the leg/arm pivots, floating status sprite and tablet screen material created by createBunnySuitOperator. As-built, the behavior tree therefore cannot animate limbs, the overhead board or the tablet screen.
stubBoundary.chamberUserDataOverwrite: The frozen facility builder overwrites chamber.userData at twin.html:10489/10507 with the catalog record, discarding indicators/jetStreams/innerLight/labelSprite. As-built, the behavior-tree purge and the 12 s standby cycle cannot animate air-shower materials, and the billboard sprite never refreshes.
stubBoundary.preservedMode: Diagnostic mode only. createBunnySuitOperator is executed once more (frozen function) and its outputs are re-attached to patrolEngineer.userData, and chamber.userData is left intact. This exposes the animation math that the frozen functions contain but the original build discards; it adds no new math. It is not original runtime behaviour.
stubBoundary.inlineBlocks: The two animation-loop bodies that own breathing and the 12 s air-shower standby cycle are not named functions; their frozen text was sliced from the animate() loop (lines 19119-19126 and 19129-19198) and executed verbatim inside wrapper functions.
stubBoundary.extraFunction: createBunnySuitOperator (9295-9468) is additionally sliced because frozen buildCleanroomPersonnel calls it; this keeps badge colors, tablet material and status-sprite construction original instead of stubbing them.
stubBoundary.waypointDwellFinding: Frozen PATROL_WAYPOINTS never resets stateTimer on arrival; it accumulates while walking and is only reset when the waypoint index advances. Every travel leg takes 6.7-12.6 s while inspect durations are 3.0-4.5 s, so the index advances on the arrival tick and no inspect/countdown frame is observable. waypointTrace records ticks per heading leg and the arrival tick; the arrival status text is still set (and captured) inside that same call.
